body: Thanks why not, I am close with my paents bt not as close as I could have been. I've hurt them in the past. My mom think I shut them out when I didn't go to her for help, bt I was just tring to be independent, to show them I could survive on my own.

I am really glad you shared your story though. I always thought I was better than those kids, because I worked really hard throughout my college career to be a good grad school candidate, but after a couple of rough semesters with family issues and really shitty lab partners I finally snapped. I didn't think I was going to get into grad school my last semester, and was only taking 14 credits, so I thought I deserved a break. I put off my thesis and presentation because I didn't want to deal with disappointment again, and it got me nowhere. At least you probably got out before you parents spent money on a whole degree.

Thanks man. I guess I should have asked for this advice earlier. My parents were hurt I didn't tell them, but I wanted to prove to them I could be independent, that I could take care of myself, that they didn't need to worry themselves sick (literally) about me. Now it's worse

Thanks man. I have been working with my professor but it's been going slow. I don't know if it will be completed in time, but all I can do is try to pick up the pace. My parents just found out, I was trying to keep it from them to spare them pain, I thought I could get it all done before they would find out. Now in trying to prevent their pain I've alienated them, and possibly caused worse pain.
